title: Faces
actors: Kalesh Ramanand, Hannah Reji, Arjun Gopal
plot: Nitya suffers from PTSD after her boyfriend Michael vanishes. She sees his face in strangers everywhere. As she searches for answers, her perspective guides us through the mystery of his disappearance and her psychological struggles.

title: Nawab Cafe

plot: Ranganath owns a café named “Nawab Cafe” in the Old City of Hyderabad, a place that carries a legacy of over four centuries. Raja, Ranganath’s son, dislikes his father’s business and dreams of settling abroad. However, unexpected circumstances force him to take over the café, where he soon finds himself facing hidden challenges.

title: Leader
actors: Aishwarya, Amritha Aiyer, Vel Arunachalam
plot: An ordinary man becomes trapped between warring criminal factions and law enforcement, forcing him to use his wits to survive while shielding his loved ones from the deadly crossfire that threatens to consume them all.

title: Mr and Mrs Bachelor
actors: Anaswara Rajan, Indrajith Sukumaran, Dayyana Hameed

title: Kara

The story follows Karasaami, a man trying to distance himself from a troubled past. However, over the course of 16 days, circumstances force him to revisit buried memories and face difficult choices. As he attempts to protect those who depend on him, his journey takes unexpected turns, blending emotional drama with a tense heist-driven narrative.

title: Jetlee
actors: Satya, Rhea Singha, Vennela Kishore, Viva Harsha
plot: A Swingfisher flight from Dubai to Kochi carries businessman Prajapathi, who fled India after defaulting on bank loans. Also on board are Indian agents, including Shivani, tasked with bringing him back. Among the passengers is Dr. Ved Vyas, who claims to be a blind doctor.But is Ved Vyas really a doctor, an agent, or someone else entirely? How does he seem to know everything? And how does this mid-air extraction mission unfold and conclude?

title: Derby
actors: Adam Sabiq, Sagar Surya, AL Ameen, Jasnya Jayadeesh
plot: Arjun, Sandeep, Yousuf, Shawn, Hibathullah, and Maria form the core friend group at the heart of Derby. Arjun, Sandeep, and Maria already share a bond from their Plus Two days, and the film follows all six through three action-packed years of college life — complete with ragging wars against seniors, unexpected romances, a memorable college tour, and the kind of chaotic moments that only college can produce. The story is episodic by design, and that structure works well in capturing how college life actually feels — a series of unforgettable incidents strung together by friendship.

title: Gaayapadda Simham
actors: Tharun Bhascker Dhaassyam, Faria Abdullah, Sree Vishnu, J.D. Chakravarthi
production: Surya Prakash Jyosula, Kasyap Sreenivas, India
plot: Darahas meets YouTuber Shalini through an arranged match, and the two soon agree to get married. However, things take a turn when Shalini discovers that Darahas shares a long-standing connection with her father. When she questions him, her father begins to reveal Darahas’s past and his link to gangster Brutal Dharma. The story then unfolds how Darahas was deported from the USA, leading to his breakup with his girlfriend, how he comes into contact with a man skilled in black magic, and how all these characters are interconnected.

title: Red Label
actors: R.V. Udhaya Kumar, Lenin, Anu Mohan, Munishkanth
plot: A gritty thriller set in the Tamil hinterland where a hidden truth emerges and one man must choose between silence and standing up for justice. An ex-student leader returns to campus politics to confront a bully.

title: Madhuvidhu
actors: Sharafudheen, Kalyani Panicker, Shyni Vijayan
plot: A newlywed couple’s dreams of happiness fade as everyday pressures mount. What began with promise turns into a test of endurance, with each day requiring more effort to bridge the growing gap between them.

title: Sathi Leelavathi

Eventually, he grows distant from her and asks for a divorce. He hires a lawyer, played by VTV Ganesh. Leela suspects that Sethu is in a relationship with another woman. What happens next? Will she agree to the divorce, and who is the other woman? The answers form the rest of the story.

actors: Fredrick John, Ayraa Palak, Chandini Tamilarasan

title: Vellakuthira
actors: Harish Ori Arthanari, Abhirami Bose, Regin Rose

actors: Vinod Kumar, Meera Raaj, Sai Simhadri, Inturi Vasu

title: Anthony

As he struggles to balance his responsibilities toward his profession and his family, a tender love story unfolds, shaping his choices and testing his values. Daily life within the fishing community its hardships, traditions, and unspoken bonds, forms the backdrop of the narrative. When personal desires begin to clash with family expectations, the protagonist is forced to confront sacrifice, loyalty, and the true meaning of love. Through moments of romance, conflict, and emotional depth, the film reveals the strength of family ties and the resilience of a community that survives by trusting the sea and each other.

title: Dhurandhar The Revenge
actors: Ranveer Singh, Akshaye Khanna, Sanjay Dutt, Arjun Rampal, Madhavan
plot: Dhurandhar The Revenge the second instalment revolves around Hamza Ali Mazari, an Indian agent locked in a high-stakes battle against Pakistan’s ISI chief, Major Iqbal, The narrative traces Jaskirat Singh Rangi’s transformation into Hamza, how he navigates enemy territory with restraint and grit, and whether he ultimately succeeds in his mission as Sher-e-Baloch. The film answers all these questions while keeping the stakes consistently high.

title: Thimmarajupalli TV
actors: Sai Tej, Veda Jallandar, Anshuman, Chittibabu, Veda Jallandar
plot: In a remote village in 1996, where a single television brings the community together, its sudden disappearance sparks chaos and suspicion. As the search begins, one man gets entangled in the mystery, leading to unexpected consequences.

title: Mr. X

production: Manu Anand, Divyanka, Raam H. Puthran, India
plot: When a lost nuclear device resurfaces in the enemy’s hands, India orders the execution of its own captured spy. A rogue agent defies orders, uncovering a conspiracy that may ignite World War III. Inspired by real espionage, honey trapping and nuclear threats, Mr. X is a relentless race against time that never stops from the word go.

title: Arivaan
actors: Ananth Nag, Janany Kunaseelan, Boys Rajan, Birla Bose
plot: Surya, an honest yet hot-tempered cop known for his encounter killings, is transferred to Neyveli following another controversial case. Soon after his arrival, a murder involving a woman named Vinisha shakes the town. As Surya dives into the case, he must navigate between truth and deceit to protect both love and justice.

title: Kaalidas 2
actors: Bharath Srinivasan, Ajay Karthi, Abarnathi, Bhavani Sre, Ananth Nag
plot: Cop Kaalidas investigates strange murders across the city. Mysterious Stephen spreads lethal mayhem from within and beyond, sparking a dark pursuit of justice, retribution, and concealed reality.

title: Arjun Son of Vyjayanthi
actors: Nandamuri Kalyan Ram, Saiee Manjrekar, Vijayashanti, Sohail Khan, Meka Srikanth
production: Hari Krishna Bhandari, Pradeep Chilukuri, Srikanth Vissa, India
plot: Vyjayanthi is a top cop who wants her son Arjun to follow in her footsteps. But unfortunately, Arjun takes the wrong path and becomes a messiah of the masses, turning into a dreaded gangster. Things take a turn when a top cop, played by Srikanth, enters the scene and urges Arjun to surrender. Arjun refuses, further distancing himself from his mother. The rest of the story revolves around how Arjun takes on the mantle of saving the poor from the evils of society, going against the very system where his mother has an important place to call the shots.

title: Neelira
actors: Naveen Chandra, Roopa Kodayur, Rohit Kokate
plot: Under distress in the civil war of the 1980s, a family’s attempt in a Northern Sri Lankan village to marry off their daughter is troubled by the unexpected events in their house on the wedding eve.

From here, the film moves into flashbacks showing Hari’s romantic past with Saraswati, also known as Saru or Juliet. Most of these sequences help explain how he ended up in prison.

title: Vaazha II: Biopic of a Billion Bros
actors: Hashir H, Alan Bin Siraj, Ajin Joy, Vinayak V
plot: Four friends labeled as losers and troublemakers embark on an emotional journey of self-discovery as they face mounting social pressure. They learn to embrace their responsibilities and find success on their own terms.

plot: The story of Kannan, a determined young badminton player dreaming of representing India at the Olympics, and his aimless best friend Bineesh. As Kannan pushes toward his goal, Bineesh undergoes his own transformation, discovering purpose and growing into a hardworking young man. Set in Vellithooval – in Idukki, the film blends dreams, responsibility, and friendship as each person becomes a driving force in Kannan’s rise as a winner.

title: Nadhi

plot: Based on a true incident, a young innocent couple`s life is driven into a war against the impacts of the corrupted social discriminations in order to achieve their dreams.

plot: Jeni and priyanka are best friends andambitious medical students with dreams of making a difference in the world.their bond is unbreakable. however, their lives take a tragic turn when jenigets brutally raped and dies unexpectedly. devastated by the loss, priya isconsumed by grief and anger. she decides to seek justice for her friend’suntimely death. as she navigates the complex legal process, she becomesincreasingly disillusioned with the system and status quo.

title: Oh Butterfly
actors: Nivedhithaa Sathish, Cibi Bhuvana Chandran, Attul
plot: A woman brings her partner to an isolated hill house for a retreat. She plans to reveal a life-changing secret, but strange events begin to occur. This mystery thriller uses butterfly imagery to explore hidden truths.

title: Aadu 3

plot: In the year 2370, Earth is ruled by an authoritarian regime known as the Organization, which seeks a rare celestial element called Star Dust, believed to possess the power to alter timelines. In 1790 CE, Maharaja Padmanabhan Thampuran presides over a kingdom while secretly guarding a truth linked to the same substance, amid peasant revolts, colonial greed, and the threat of invasion. In the present, Shaji Pappan and his associates, fresh from their victory over old adversaries, stumble into a conspiracy that binds their fate to events unfolding across centuries. As these timelines converge, actions taken in one era begin to reshape reality in another, culminating in a rupture that propels key characters across time.

title: Biker
actors: Sharwanand, Malvika Nair, Rajasekhar, Atul Kulkarni, Dayanand Reddy, Brahmaji
production: MVS Bharadwaj, Abhilash Reddy Kankara, Shravan Madala, India
plot: The story is set in 2003 in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Vikas Narayan is India’s top motocross champion, trained rigorously by his father and coach, Sunil Narayan. Sunil makes immense sacrifices to shape Vikas into a champion and secures him a sponsorship with a major corporate sports company, ING, headed by Indraneel. Just as Vikas is set to prepare for an international championship, he abruptly leaves Coimbatore without informing his father. Years later, he is settled in another city with his wife and their child. What led Vikas to walk away from both his father and the sport at the peak of his career? Will he reunite with his father and reclaim his glory?

title: The Kerala Story 2 Goes Beyond
actors: Ulka Gupta, Aishwarya Ojha, Aditi Bhatia
production: Amarnath Jha, Vipul Amrutlal Shah, India

plot: Veeru returns from the USA to his village, only to find the locals terrified of a nearby fort believed to be possessed by a demon. According to village lore, the demon demands a human sacrifice every few years, with ominous signs appearing in the sky when the time arrives. By a twist of fate, Veeru ends up stepping in as the chosen sacrifice. Will he escape the fort safely? What will his girlfriend Subbalaxmi and his friend Balu do to rescue him?

title: Manithan Deivamagalam
actors: K. Selvaraghavan, Mime Gopi, Y.G. Mahendran
plot: Set against a rural backdrop, the story revolves around tensions linked to land and belief systems. As the conflict unfolds, the central character evolves into a guardian figure, driven by circumstances rather than choice. The premise holds relevance, especially in the way it reflects real-life issues tied to identity and community.

title: TN 2026

plot: Set in Pollachi, the story follows a powerful landlord, Sivalingam Mandradiyar, who becomes obsessed with a rising actor, Kukanth Kumar, believing he is the next M.G.R. He pours his wealth into shaping the actor’s career and political future. But as ambition and fame grow, so does the risk of downfall. Will it lead to power or ruin?

title: Viraaji
actors: Varun Sandesh, Raghu Karumanchi, Pramodini, Balagam Jayaram

plot: Galatta Family is a Tamil movie starring Vemal, Anicka Vikhraman, Thambi Ramaiah, Mottai Rajendran, Anandaraj and Meera Krishnan in prominent roles. It is directed by A. Sarkunam.

title: Prathichaya
actors: Vishnu Agasthya, Sabitha Anand, Harisree Ashokan
plot: After Kerala’s Chief Minister dies in a scandal engineered by a ruthless media tycoon, his son a brilliant tech entrepreneur enters the blood-soaked arena of politics to expose the conspiracy, vindicate his father, and turn technology against those who weaponized it

title: Nee Forever
actors: Chella, Sudharsan Govind, Y.G. Mahendran
plot: Ajay, a startup app developer, and Mathi, an aspiring director, enter a fake relationship while hiding their true identities from each other. What starts as a calculated arrangement soon turns into an emotional journey as unexpected feelings grow between them.

title: Happy Raj
actors: G.V. Prakash Kumar, Sri Gouri Priya, Prathana Nathan
plot: Anand Raj aka Happy might have all the looks that impresses women but get rejected solely for the oddball his father Kaatha Muthu is. Often rebuked as kuthira muttai, his father doesn’t let it impact him as much as Happy does. But Happy finally falls for Kavya who not only reciprocates his feelings but also is okay with his father. Things aren’t the same when their families meet, leading to the rise of complicated and hilarious situations.

title: Lechindi Mahila Lokam
actors: Supritha Naidu, Lakshmi Manchu, Shraddha Das, Sreerama Chandra
production: Carthyk-Arjun, Mahi Illindra, Vishwa Karun, India
plot: The story revolves around a married couple whose petty disputes spiral into a thrilling and hilarious conspiracy, fueled by meddling neighbors and friends. What starts as simple disagreements quickly escalates into a comically chaotic situation, blending humor with suspense.

title: Shamitabh
actors: Amitabh Bachchan, Dhanush, Akshara Haasan
plot: Danish is a dumb boy from a village in Maharashtra. Even though he cant talk, he aspires to be an actor, the typical Hindi film hero. With this intension, he goes to bollywood and manages to convince an assistant director Akshara that he can act. Akshara’s attempts to get him in to the industry failed due to his inability to talk. But an advanced technology helps Danish to speak in a very constrained manner. The struggling actor finds this drunkard guy named Amitabh Sinha who had a solid voice. The movie basically tells us the combined journey of Danish and Amitabh as Shamitabh.

title: Nota
actors: Vijay Devarakonda, Mehreen Peerzad, Nassar, Sathyaraj
plot: Varun is forced to become the CM of Tamil Nadu when his father is imprisoned and loses his CM chair. He is an easy going youth who stays the same even after becoming the CM until he realizes his responsibilities and power and decides to change the society and politics with the support of his advisor Mahendran.

title: Kadukka
actors: Vijay Gowrish, Aadharsh Madhikaandham, KVN Manimegalai
plot: In a peaceful village, two best friends find themselves falling for the same girl, turning their friendship into a light-hearted rivalry. As they each try to win her heart in their own quirky ways, unexpected twists and playful misunderstandings add to the chaos. But the girl has a secret that could change everything, leading to a surprising outcome.

title: Azhaikkamal Vanthai
actors: Thevaguru, Pavetraa Reddy, Pavetraa Reddy
plot: A wife’s suspicion of infidelity turns into terror when she discovers her husband has secretly built an AI woman who soon becomes obsessively determined to replace her.

title: Mustafa Mustafa
actors: Chaams, Maheshwari Chanakyan, Monica Chinnakotla
plot: On the verge of marriage, TV anchor Karthik’s life unravels when an embarrassing video leaks online. With his best friend Vasu and hacker Chitti, he dives into chaotic cover-ups, racing against time to save his reputation before everything goes viral.

title: Kolai Seval
actors: Deepa Balu, Gajaraj, Kalaiyarasan
plot: A family follows a 200-year-old tradition of visiting a forest temple when a woman becomes pregnant. When a nine-month-pregnant woman is taken there, she encounters unexpected danger, uncovering dark secrets behind the temple and the mysterious forest.

title: Valathu Vashathe Kallan
actors: Vyshnavi Raj, Biju Menon, Joju George
plot: CI Antony Xavier, a very typical police officer who prefers amicable settlement over proper investigation, is our main character. At one point, Xavier was in charge of the investigation of a missing woman case. The father of the girl, Samuel, had no faith in the investigation led by someone like Antony Xavier. What we see here is the plan setout by Samuel that puts Antony Xavier in a difficult situation.

title: Kaa: The Forest
actors: Andrea Jeremiah, Salim Ghouse, Marimuthu
plot: When a cold-blooded killer, Victor Mahadev, and his ruthless gang hunt two boys into a dense forest, a wildlife photographer, Venba Subbaiya, is accidentally pulled into their deadly game. Trapped deep in the wilderness, survival becomes the only law as a brutal battle unfolds over who will live to see the next dawn.

title: Second Case of Seetharam
actors: Vijay Raghavendra, Gopalkrishna Deshpande, Usha Bhandari
plot: Inspector Seetharam, hoping to reunite with his estranged sister after years apart, must track down a brutal, psychotic serial killer terrorising the town of Anegadde.

title: Suyodhana
actors: Priya Darshi, Drishika Chander, Sai Kumar
plot: A young Foley artist, haunted since childhood by a mysterious voice and visions of a figure in Duryodhana’s form, grows up under the care of his mother and close relationships. His life takes a dark turn when he is accused of his father’s murder, and the investigation begins to unravel hidden truths about his past.

title: Ashakal Aayiram
actors: Asha Sharath, Jayaram, Kalidas Jayaram
production: Jude Anthany Joseph, Aravind Rajendran, India

title: Youth
actors: Ken Karunas, Anishma Anilkumar, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Priyanshi Yadav
plot: Praveen, a teenager who has just cleared his 10th exam with passing marks. His equation with his father is troublesome, and his mother is his only supporter. She is doing some unthinkable stuff to get Praveen a seat in the same school for 12th grade. What we see here is how romance changes and shapes Praveen’s life during the two years of his Plus Two life.

title: Ustaad Bhagat Singh
actors: Pawan Kalyan, Raashi Khanna, Sreeleela, Radhakrishnan Parthiban
production: Mithun Chaitanya, Dasaradh, Chandra Mohan, India
plot: Bhagat Singh, a former police officer, now leads a quiet life in the Nallamala forests. Into this setting arrives a wealthy industrialist, who plans a pre-wedding celebration for his younger daughter at a forest resort. Meanwhile, his elder daughter Sloka is struggling to move on from a painful breakup. Bhagat Singh takes it upon himself to ensure the family’s safety. At the same time, Telangana Chief Minister Nalla Nagappa’s son enters the forest for a private party, only to be abducted by Bhagat Singh. In response, Nagappa deploys a jihadi group to rescue his son. But what drives Bhagat Singh to kidnap the Chief Minister’s son? How is this extremist group connected to his past operations as a police officer in Hyderabad? What happened to his lover Leela? And will Bhagat Singh succeed in installing the right leader as the new Chief Minister?

title: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu
actors: Neethu Krishna, Askar Ali, Sidharth Bharathan
plot: The story unfolds in a dense forest along the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border, where a mysterious forest has long been associated with people who enter but never return. The film begins with three Kerala Police officers venturing into the supposedly haunted forest in search of a missing Tamil Nadu police officer. As their investigation progresses, they encounter strange phenomena involving time loops and elements of time travel. Gradually, the narrative reveals the hidden mysteries surrounding the Velloorkkatt forest.

title: Iravin Vizhigal
actors: Ashmitha, Mahendraa, Scissor Manohar
plot: In a world asleep in the web’s darkness, one man awakens like the eyes of the night. Driven by anger and purpose, he confronts hidden evils online, seeking justice and redemption in a society lost to digital shadows.

title: S.Saraswath
actors: Varalaxmi Sarathkumar, Prakash Raj, Priyamani, Jiiva, Kishore Kumar
plot: Lakshmi lives with her young daughter Saraswathi. After dropping her daughter off at school, Lakshmi returns to pick her up in the evening. The school management later revealed to Lakshmi that no girl with the name Saraswathi is even studying at their school. Upset with this, Lakshmi finds her way to locate her daughter, only to know that she has been brutally raped. How she comes to terms with the ghastly incident and how she takes revenge on the culprits is the basic story of the film.

title: Thaai Kizhavi
actors: Radhika Sarathkumar, Aruldoss, Ilavarasu, George Maryan
plot: Set against the backdrop of a small rural village, Thaai Kizhavi follows the life of Pavunuthayi, a feared yet respected 70 year old woman who works as a moneylender. Known for her sharp tongue and uncompromising nature, she commands authority both within her household and the village at large. She lives with her daughter and grandson, while remaining deliberately estranged from her three sons for years.

title: Naangal
actors: Abdul Rafe, Mithun, Rithik Mohan
plot: Naangal is the poignant journey of three siblings, un-identical twins and their elder brother, who are caught between a distant mother and a controlling, frustrated father grappling with personal and financial collapse. Living in a crumbling mansion without necessities, the children navigate a harsh world ruled by fear, obedience, and emotional isolation. Torn between their maternal grandparents` warmth and their father`s cold discipline, they learn to find strength, joy, and resilience in each other growing up in silence, yet growing strong.

title: Kadhal Kadhai Sollava
actors: Vijay Sethupathi, Jayaram, Nakhul
plot: The story centers around a popular radio show where people of all ages share their personal love stories. Through this unique platform, two different romantic journeys unfold and gradually connect, highlighting love beyond age, time, and social boundaries.

title: Kadhal Reset Repeat
actors: Madumkesh, Jiya Shankar, Arjun Ashokan
plot: Jiya Shankar is a passionate musician who is in Scotland to participate in an international talent show, where she meets with an accident and forgets her past. Her boyfriend Madumkesh bringing back her sweet memories forms the remaining story.

title: Sarkeet
actors: Asif Ali, Divya Prabha, Alexander Prasanth, Remya Suresh
plot: Jeppu has ADHD, and his parents, Balu and Stephy, find it difficult to raise him amidst their busy lives. In the meantime, Ameer is struggling to find a steady job and support himself and his mother. An improbable circumstance brings their lives together, resulting in a poignant friendship.

title: Partners
actors: Dhyan Sreenivasan, Madhusudhan Rao, Aneesh Gopal
production: Hariprasad, Naveen John, K.V. Prasanth, India
plot: Income Tax Commissioner Parthasaradhi is investigating a scam centered around a low-key private bank and one of its branches in rural Kasaragod. Six months ago, five new employees were recruited and tried to win the locals’ trust.

title: Abinaya
actors: M. Karnan Kanapathy, Hamsni Perumal, Tokoh Sathia
plot: A romantic comedy directed by Devendran Arunasalam, and stars Karnan Kanapathy, Hamsni Perumal, Tokoh Sathia and others.

title: Sabdham
actors: Aadhi Pinisetty, Lakshmi Menon, Simran, Laila, Redin Kingsley
plot: Holy Angels Medical College, a prestigious institution, finds itself in the news for all the wrong reasons multiple unexplained suicides. Rumors swirl among students, hinting at paranormal activity, forcing the administration to bring in Mr. Vyoma, a seasoned investigator of the supernatural. As he delves into the mystery, he unearths dark secrets buried within the institution.

title: Saroja Samannikkallo
actors: Shivarun, Sunitha Thomas, Darling Madhan
plot: The screenplay explores how women who have been sexually assaulted by a supernatural force emerge from this ordeal—and who, or what, that supernatural entity is.

title: Repu Udayam 10 Gantalaku
actors: Chaitanya Rao, Hebah Patel, Abhinav Gomatam, Kireeti Damaraju
plot: The story revolves around a critical deadline set for 10 a.m. the next day. As time runs out, the characters are caught in a tense race against the clock, trying to escape a dangerous situation and survive the unfolding crisis.

title: Aaradhana
actors: Auro Chakkravarthy, Sri Kalirajan Marimuthu, Sri Kumaran Munusamy
plot: Pregnant doctor Maya moves to a village with her husband Pradeep, but their peace shatters when a skeleton awakens a vengeful spirit. Pradeep becomes possessed, writing about a wronged woman, Aaradhana. As danger grows, Maya uncovers the truth and confronts the spirit, saving herself and her child, though Pradeep’s fate remains uncertain.

title: Vishnu Vinyasam
actors: Sree Vishnu, Nayana Sarika, Satya
plot: Vishnu is a junior lecturer at a college. While the senior lecturers refuse to have him assigned to them, Manisha voluntarily chooses him to be part of her faculty team. To his surprise, she soon asks him out and quickly proposes, leaving Vishnu confused. However, due to his obsession with numerology and horoscope matching, he agrees to the relationship after learning that their numbers are perfectly aligned. Nayan Sarika plays her role in a bold manner in the first half — portraying traits like drinking, smoking, and even initiating lip-locks. At the same time, she looks cute on screen and delivers a convincing performance.

title: Thadai Athai Udai
actors: Angadi Theru Mahesh, Guna Babu, Thiruvarur Ganesh
plot: Three aspiring filmmakers from a humble brick kiln background set out to prove their talent. After their first village drama is dismissed, they reinvent themselves. What begins as a daring YouTube channel stunt soon spirals into danger, loss, and shocking revelation all part of their bold second film. This unexpected, twisted narrative ultimately wins over a producer, marking the true beginning of their filmmaking journey.

title: Sampradayini Suppini Suddapoosani
actors: Sivaji, Laya, Rohan, Mohammad Ali, Dhanraj
plot: Sriram, a village secretary, leads a modest life with his wife Uttara and their son Bittu in a village near Horsley Hills in Madanapalle, Andhra Pradesh. The local police officer Vikram develops a rivalry with Sriram. Over time, his hostility takes a dangerous turn as he sets his sights on Sriram’s wife. One day, when Sriram is away on work, Vikram enters the secretary’s house with bad intentions toward Uttara. However, the situation takes an unexpected turn and Vikram ends up dead inside the house. How does Sriram deal with this crisis? Can he save his family from being dragged into a murder case? Who killed the police?

title: Vadam
actors: Vemal, Natty Subramaniam, Sanashka Sri, Bala Saravanan
plot: Vadam explores the hero’s extraordinary bond with his bull and is based on Vada Manju Virattu. The film emotionally highlights family relationships.

title: My Lord
actors: M. Sasikumar, Chaithra J. Achar, V. Jayaprakash

actors: Adith Arun, Hebah Patel, Akhil Raj, Siri Hanmanth, Prithveeraj
plot: Eesha is about a group of four friends who decide to expose fake Godmen in the country and target Aadhi Dev. When they meet him, Aadhi challenges the gang to spend three nights in a haunted house and prove that evil spirits do not exist. The gang accepts the challenge, but little do they know what they are getting into

title: Konja Naal Poru Thalaiva
actors: Lollu Sabha Maaran, Motta Rajendran, Nishanth Russo
plot: A young man working in a private company falls in love with a girl who is searching for a job. Their relationship is disrupted when he clashes with a local goon who attacks his uncle. Hurt and disappointed, the girl distances herself from him, pushing him into deep despair. When he tries to end his life, he is stopped by a ghost who once committed suicide. What follows is a journey that reminds him why every life is worth fighting for.

title: Seetha Payanam
actors: Niranjan Sudhindra, Aishwarya Arjun, Sathyaraj, Prakash Raj
production: Sai Madhav Burra, Arjun Sarja, India
plot: Seetha loses her mother in childhood, and her father, Rajendra Prasad, raises her with immense love, becoming both mother and father. They share a close bond, but Seetha always avoids the topic of marriage. She travels from Vizag to Hyderabad for work, where she meets Abhi. During the journey, a few unexpected incidents change her life.

title: The Intruders
actors: Miranda Cosgrove, Donal Logue, Austin Butler
plot: The disturbed twenty year-old Rose Halshford moves with her father, the architect Jerry Halshford, to an old house after the loss of her mother. Soon Rose meets her next door neighbor Leila Markby and she learns about the tragic disappearance of the teenager Rachel that was sheltered by the previous owner of her house, Cheri Garrison and her son Marcus. Rose suspects Leila’s father Howard Markby and she also learns that he had been the prime suspect of the police but proved his innocence. Rose overhears noises in the house but her father believes she is still traumatized by the loss of her mother. Rose also dates the constructor Noah Henry that

title: Hey Balwanth
actors: Suhas, Shivani Nagaram, V.K. Naresh, Sudharshan, Vennela Kishore
production: Gopi Atchara, Shanmukha Prasanth, Midhun Shankar Reddy, India
plot: The story is set in Guntur. Krishna falls in love with Mithra, an idealistic young woman determined to serve society through her NGO. While Mithra is driven by purpose, Krishna has only one ambition in life: to take over and expand his father’s business. However, he has no real idea what his father actually does. When Krishna discovers that his father runs a lodge that operates as a front for prostitution, his world comes crashing down. Disillusioned and heartbroken, he begins to resent and distance himself from his father. Complications arise when Mithra’s grandfather lands at the same lodge. From that moment, Krishna and Mithra’s relationship take dramatic and unforeseen turns.

title: Funky
actors: Vishwak Sen, V.K. Naresh, Kayadu Lohar
plot: Maya lives to dance, but later reality dims her dreams. A quirky local crew reignites her passion through rehearsals, jam sessions, and street battles. With her new friends, she learns to embrace the chaos and be unapologetically herself.

title: Karuppu Pulsar
actors: Dinesh, Kalaiyarasan, Mansoor Ali Khan
plot: The story is set against the cultural backdrop of Jallikattu, a traditional sport in Tamil Nadu. Rooted in rural culture, it revolves around two men whose lives intersect in unexpected ways. One is from Chennai, and he owns a Pulsar motorcycle, which is haunted and kills people. The other man is from Madurai and owns a bull named Karuppu.

title: Couple Friendly
actors: Santosh Sobhan, Manasa Varanasi, Yogi Babu
plot: Shiva, a native of Nellore, moves to Chennai hoping to make it big as an interior designer. There, he meets Mithra, who has arrived from Chittoor in search of an IT job. Following an unexpected turn of events, she ends up staying in his room as a paying guest, and the two gradually fall in love. Meanwhile, Shiva begins to find success in his profession. While his parents readily accept their relationship, Mithra’s parents strongly oppose it. As the couple struggles to win them over, an unforeseen incident turns their lives forever.

title: Yogida
actors: Dhansika, Kabir Duhan Singh, Sayaji Shinde

title: Will
actors: Sonia Agarwal, Padam Venu Kumar, Mohan Raman

title: Bhartha Mahasayulaku Wignyapthi
actors: Ravi Teja, Dimple Hayathi, Satya, Sunil, Vennela Kishore

title: Zombie Strippers
actors: Jenna Jameson, Robert Englund, Roxy Saint

title: Made in Korea
actors: Priyanka Arulmohan, Park Hye-jin, Jaehyun Jang
plot: Shenba, a young woman from a small village Kolappur, down south Tamil Nadu, dreams of going to Korea one day. And in a sudden turn of events, she ends up on a one-way flight to Seoul, but in the least of situations expected.

title: Lockdown
actors: Anupama Parameswaran, Revathi, Abhirami
plot: Anitha is the obedient eldest daughter of her family. But, a traumatic incident turns her world upside down, that’s further intensified during COVID lockdown.

title: Alli
actors: Joju George, Nimisha Sajayan, Akhil Viswanath
production: K.V. Manikandan, Sanal Kumar Sasidharan, India
plot: Teenager Janaki departs for a day in the city at dawn. Her suitor has arranged for a ride with his boss, a sullen and dark man. The whole thing becomes a giant twisted surprise when the boss lets Janaki know that he is aware that Janaki is there without her mother’s permission.

title: Fourth Floor
actors: Deepshika, Thalaivasal Vijay, Adithya Kathir, Subramaniam Siva
plot: Drawn back to Chennai by a call from his former lover, Dheeren checks into a secluded guest house where unsettling events and vivid dreams begin to haunt him. As dreams and reality blur, he realises the visions are clues tied to his past and his ex-lover’s fate, forcing him to confront buried truths before the guest house claims him next.

title: With Love
actors: Kavya Anil, Sacchin Nachiappan, Anaswara Rajan, Abishan Jeevinth
plot: Sathya reluctantly agrees to a blind date arranged by his sister and meets Monisha. They discover they attended the same school years ago. Bonding over shared memories and old crushes, they reconnect with their past and grow closer.

title: Dear Radhi
actors: Mano Ve Kannathasan, Saravana Vickram, Rajesh Balachandiran
plot: Madhan goes on a one-day date with Radhi, a beautiful girl who works at a spa; the day spirals into a dangerous chase as both the police and a gang hunt for Radhi, ending in a shocking truth that reveals their connection.

title: Granny
actors: Dileepan, Gajaraj, Master Ghanshyam, Ananth Nag
plot: A techie couple returns to their remote ancestral home, encountering an eerie old woman named Occhai. Her buried past holds a terrifying truth intertwined with a mysterious village death.

title: Subedaar
actors: Vikram Malhotra, Anil Kapoor, Suresh Triveni
plot: Set against the rugged backdrop of the Indian heartland, Subedaar follows Arjun Maurya, a decorated and battle-scarred retired soldier who finds that the transition to civilian life is a war of its own. As he attempts to navigate a deeply fractured relationship with his daughter, Shyama, he discovers his town has fallen under the oppressive shadow of a ruthless illegal sand mining mafia led by the chilling Prince and the whimsical yet menacing Babli Didi. Forced to trade his hopes for a peaceful retirement with his old instincts of discipline and duty, Arjun must confront both his inner demons and a corrupt societal system to protect his family and restore his sense of honour.

title: Kannadi
actors: Rahul Madhav, Siddique, Rachana Narayanan Kutty
plot: A young couple find themselves in a terrifying situation after their car meets with an accident near a cemetery. After they return home, everything seems normal except when they look in the mirror.

title: Pookie
actors: Vijay Antony, Dhanusha, Ajay Dhishan
plot: He struggles to tell her he wants to separate. When he finally does, she shares the same thoughts. Suddenly realizing he doesn’t want to lose her, they reconcile though both still privately consider breaking up.

title: Friday
actors: Dheena, Ramachandran Durairaj, Mime Gopi
plot: Mani, a determined gangster seeking revenge for his brothers death, sets out to kill Jagan, a feared local don. But when his trusted ally Gopi jeopardizes the plan, Mani abandons the mission to protect him. Forced into hiding, Mani finally reveals the painful truth of how his brother was killed six months ago, setting the stage for a tense journey fueled by loyalty, loss and vengeance.

title: Honey
actors: Naveen Chandra, Divya Pillai, Divi Vadthya
plot: A broken family,a forbidden ritual,and a girl caught between the real and the unreal.Honey is a haunting tale of systemic abuse,spiritual delusion,and the invisible horrors inflicted on children,where the darkest monsters aren’t imaginary.

title: Ondimuniyum Nallapaadanum
actors: Karthikesan, Murugan, Parotta Murugesan
plot: Nallapaadan, a dedicated farmer and worshipper of the deity Ondimuni, plans to offer his prized goat in gratitude after believing his son has been saved by the divine. His intention collides with a feud between local upper-caste individuals that has halted the annual festival dedicated to the deity. As the conflict escalates, Nallapaadan must navigate social divisions to fulfil his vow and protect his community’s faith.

title: Hero Friend U
actors: Thevaguru Suppiah, Kavitha Sinniah, Shabby Sharath Nair
plot: Two best friends who run a business helping men escape the “friend zone.” Chaos and comedy ensue when one of these “experts” unexpectedly finds himself friend-zoned by his own dream girl

title: Guardian
actors: Saiju Kurup, Sijoy Varghese, Miya George
plot: Doctor Arun and his wife Sruthi Samuel are our main protagonists. At one point, Sruthi gets a blackmailing phone call from a stranger claiming that he will release some sensitive pieces of information about her past relationship if she doesn’t agree to pay a ransom amount. Doctor Arun steps in to play the protector’s role, and in the process, he commits certain crimes. How he manages to escape from the legal troubles is what we see in Guardian.

title: Lucky the Superstar
actors: G.V. Prakash Kumar, Anaswara Rajan, R. Sarathkumar
plot: The lost pup soon finds a home when a family adopts him and names him Lucky, blissfully unaware that the dog possesses an extraordinary ability to bring immense fortune to whoever owns him. What begins as a warm, slice-of-life setup quickly spirals into chaos when Lucky goes missing. His disappearance leads him straight into the hands of a group of corrupt politicians who uncover his secret and see him as the ultimate shortcut to power and popularity.

title: Kutram Thavir
actors: Aradhya, S. Deepak Darshin, Dayanand
plot: Kutram Thavir follows Rudra, whose elder sister dies due to a fraudulent medical insurance scheme, leading him to uncover a conspiracy exploiting the poor. Consumed by grief and anger, he sets out to seek revenge and expose the truth behind her death.

title: Irunda Nilalin Ragasiyam
actors: Ravi Das, Sebin Ganapathiplackal, Vidya Mukundan
plot: After seven years of graduation, five friends plan a get-together in a remote village. In response to a death, their trek turns into a murder investigation by the police

title: God Bless You
actors: Jenson Alappat, Anjana Appukuttan, Sabari Boss
plot: The plot revolves around what happens to Clara and Sam four hours a day. Sam’s friend Vaishakh offers his owner the opportunity to work as a carrier for the smuggling gang. For the first time, Sam loses money and drugs. Knowing all this, Clara tries to find money for Sam.

title: Rayar Parambarai
actors: Kritika Singh Yadav, Anandraj, Anshula Dhawan
plot: Jamin controls the whole town with his goons. When he is blessed with a baby girl, he takes her horoscope to a famous astrologer to find out that she will have a love marriage with his permission. Who will she marry – the love of her life or her father`s choice?

title: LipLock
actors: Adithya RK, Adithya Kathir, Niranjana Neithiar, Raja Rani Pandian
plot: Shivaji lives in fear until a mysterious 11:11 moment brings MGR into his life. The film is directed by Aghilan Maruthamuthu and stars Adithya RK, Adithya Kathir, Niranjana Neithiar, and Raja Rani Pandian in the lead roles.

title: Bone Lake
actors: Alex Roe, Maddie Hasson, Marco Pigossi
plot: A couple’s vacation at a secluded estate is upended when they’re forced to share the mansion with a mysterious couple. A dream getaway spirals into a nightmarish maze of sex, lies, and manipulation, triggering a battle for survival.

title: Ram Abdullah Antony
actors: Arnav, Ajay Arnold, Chaams, Vinodhini Vaidynathan
plot: Three childhood friends who veer off course growing up attempt to bring their lives back on track when their error escalates beyond their grasp.

title: Jockey
actors: Yuvan Krishna, Ridhaan Krishnas, Ammu Abhirami
plot: This film presents goat fighting – a centuries-old South Indian cultural tradition – as an engaging, emotional, and entertaining cinematic experience. My intent is to make the world witness the unique relationship between goats and their handlers and showcase Madurai’s rich culture with honesty and intensity.

title: Baby Girl
actors: Nivin Pauly, Lijo Mol Jose, Jaffer Idukki, Aditi Ravi, Azees Nedumangad
plot: The story places Sanal Mathew at the centre of the chaos. Sanal is a hospital attendant who becomes important after recalling a suspicious figure leaving the hospital. From there, the baby becomes less a person and more a misplaced parcel, passed along through a chain of coincidences involving migrant workers, a desperate brother, an abusive husband, a young couple who never wanted the child, and a police force that’s constantly one step behind. The writing piles incident upon incident, but emotional clarity is sacrificed along the way.

title: Vanaveera
actors: Chammak Chandra, Simran Choudhary, Nandu Vijay Krishna
plot: A descendant of the Vanara clan is pushed into conflict when a modern-day Ravana seizes his only bike for an election rally. What starts as a petty injustice soon erupts into a fierce fight for self-respect and dignity.

title: Ellam Sheriyakum
actors: Rajisha Vijayan, Siddique, Indrans
plot: Vineeth and Ancy are this couple who got married against the will of Ancy’s father, Chacko. Vineeth is an active worker of the left-wing party LPF. Chacko is a prominent politician who represents UPF. He had to give up on his dream to be the CM because Ancy decided to elope with Vineeth when his party won the election. What forced Ancy to do that to her father and the repercussions of that in the life of Ancy and Vineeth is what we see in the movie.

title: GST (Horror) Tamil Movie
actors: Srujan Lokesh, Rajani Bharadwaj, Girija Lokesh, Ashok, Vinaya Prasad
plot: After his mother’s death, “unlucky” Lucky meets helpful ghosts and falls for Nidhi. Learning the ghosts died in a financial crisis, he aids their peace by joining their bank heist plan.

title: Hotspot 2 Much
actors: Aadhitya Baaskar, M.S. Bhaskar, Bhavani Sre, Priya Bhavani Shankar
plot: An aspiring Director, who pitches her three different stories, that depict some pressing ideological and social issues in the society, to a producer with whom she also has an hidden agenda.

title: Kaakaa
actors: Sai Dhanyaa, Theni K. Paraman, Inigo Prabhakaran
plot: Three men from different cities with contrasting personalities fall in love with two elder sisters and their younger sibling. As rivalry, confusion, and funny situations unfold, the story follows who finally wins their hearts and marries them, delivering a fun-filled romantic comedy.

title: I Am God
actors: Avinash, Aruna Balraj, Ravi Gowda, Niranjan, P. Ravi Shankar
plot: An intense love story brews between Deva and Bindhu. On the other side, a masked man who calls himself GOD shakes the city with his brutal serial killings.

title: Kombuseevi
actors: Anaira Gupta, Tharnika, Shanmuga Pandian, R. Sarathkumar
plot: Set against the backdrop of a real-life incident from 1996, Kombuseevi revolves around a protagonist caught amid village rivalries, caste conflicts, and political manipulations. The narrative follows how he navigates these layered tensions while attempting to restore balance. The first half progresses at a brisk pace with action-driven sequences, while the latter half leans more towards emotion and humour, blending commercial elements to sustain interest.

title: Thalaivar Thambi Thalaimaiyil
actors: Jiiva, Shajeer P. Basheer, Jensan Diwakar
production: Sanjo Joseph, Anuraj O.B., Nithish Sahadev, India
plot: Jeeva Ratnam, the Panchayat head of the village, is the main character. As the elections approach, he decides to visit Ilavarasu’s house, as his daughter Soumya is getting married. The equation between Ilavarasu and his neighbor Mani wasn’t that great due to some past grudge. While the preparations were happening in full swing, something unprecedented happened, and there was tension in the air. Jeeva, who wants the vote of everyone, has the task of managing gigantic egos. How he manages to do that is what we see in Thalaivar Thambi Thalaimaiyil.

title: Anaganaga Oka Raju
actors: Naveen Polishetty, Meenaakshi Chaudhary, Nag Raj Kottu, Saanve Megghana
plot: Raju is the heir of a once-wealthy family, but his grandfather squanders the property by showering it on his mistresses. Determined to marry an affluent girl, Raju meets Charulatha. Using his clever tricks, he gets close to her, only to be taken aback by a shocking twist about her.

title: Mana Shankara Vara Prasad Garu
actors: Chiranjeevi, Nayanthara, Catherine Tresa, Venkatesh Daggubati
production: S Krishna, G. Adi Narayana, Anil Ravipudi, India
plot: Prasad, a National Security officer, divorces his wife Sasirekha due to conflict with her powerful father, G.V.R. After six years, he disguises himself as a PT mentor to reconnect with his children. When a threat emerges against G.V.R., Prasad returns as his security head, uncovering a revenge plot targeting Sasirekha. He protects her, earns forgiveness, reunites with his family, while his friend Venky finds love with Jwaala.

title: IPL: Indian Penal Law
actors: Abhirami, Aranganathan, Dileepan
plot: The story follows how influential and wealthy individuals attempt to shift the blame for their misdeeds onto innocent, ordinary people, exploring the emotional and social impact it leaves behind. The teaser hints at a tense battle to retrieve sensitive information capable of toppling several politicians’ careers. The film is also expected to address the harsh realities of custodial torture, adding a strong layer of social commentary to its intense narrative.

title: Parasakthi
actors: Sivakarthikeyan, Atharvaa Murali, Sreeleela, Jayam Ravi
production: Ganeshaa, Madhan Karky, Shan Karuppusamy, USA
plot: Parasakthi, set in 1960s Tamil Nadu, follows the story of Chezhaiyan, aka Che, a young and peace-loving man. He works in the railways and is the sole breadwinner for his family, and takes care of his younger brother, Chinna Durai, a college student and activist. With civil conflict taking center stage, Chinna actively fights against systemic oppression, even though his brother disagrees. However, things take a drastic turn when a vicious police officer named Thirunaadan enters the equation, serving the government and using police brutality to curb the protests. Amidst all this, a life-changing event leads Che to undergo a significant shift in his psyche, prompting him to stand with the protests his brother is part of. How Che’s life changes over time, his bond with his sibling, and the challenges he faces form the core of the film.

title: Nilakanta
actors: Mahendran, Yashna Muthuluri, Neha Pathan
plot: In the village of Saraswathipuram, education is sacred. Nilakanta, a humble tailor, grows up wise and kind, believing in karma. Fate turns cruel, and he must bravely fight his greatest rival-destiny itself to survive. It tests his courage.

title: The Raja Saab
actors: Prabhas, Sanjay dutt, Boman Irani, Malavika Mohanan, Nidhhi Agerwal
genre: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Horror, Romance, Thriller
plot: The Raja Saab is an emotional story about a grandson and his grandmother. Raja lives with his grandmother, Gangamma. She has been waiting decades for her lost husband, Kanaka Raju, to return. One day, Raja finds a clue about where his grandfather might be. He travels to Hyderabad to bring him home. However, he discovers a shocking truth his grandfather is dead and has become an evil spirit. Raja learns that Kanaka Raju had performed black magic on Ganga Devi, who was actually the Queen of the Devanagara Kingdom, just to steal her treasure and marry her. Because of this betrayal, Ganga Devi lost everything and was forced to live in poverty with her grandson. Upon learning this, Raja goes to the haunted palace to reclaim his grandmother’s lost fortune. The rest of the story follows what happens after he enters the palace possessed by Kanaka Raju. It also explores who the three women, Nidhhi Agerwal, Malavika Mohanan, and Riddhi Kumar are and how they are connected to Prabhas and the mysteries of the palace.

title: Gatha Vaibhava
actors: SS Dushyanth, Ashika Ranganath, Kishan Bilagali, Karthik Rao
plot: The film opens with a painting. Adhunika is a painter with an air of magic. She creates a portrait of a stranger, which sows the seed of the story. When she shares it on social media, it reaches Purathan through a friend. Purathan arrives in Gonigoppa, setting off events that travel through time, locations, and beliefs. What begins as a simple meeting and conversation evolves into a tale where time feels circular rather than linear. The present connects to past lives, ranging from the shining halls of Devaloka to the restless seas that carried Vasco da Gama, and to the quiet lanes of coastal Karnataka before Independence. Adhunika’s itha’s imagination ties these lives together, making her and Purathan the keys that unlock each other’s story. Suni illustrates how a simple gesture can bridge lifetimes.

title: Nari Nari Naduma Murari
actors: Sharwanand, Samyuktha Menon, Sakshi Vaidya, Sree Vishnu
production: Ram Abbaraju, Bhanu Bhogavarapu, Nandu Savirigana, India
plot: Gautham, an architect, is in love with Nitya. Her father, Ramalingaiah, feels their relationship lacks intensity since they never fight. Though he eventually agrees to the marriage, he insists that it be conducted at a registrar office. Gautham refuses, as he has a deep personal connection with that place from his past. Determined to make the wedding happen peacefully, Gautham tries to sort things out, but events do not go in his favour.

title: Bhavani Ward 1997
actors: Ganesh Reddy Budupu, Gayatri Gupta, Vijayesh Jalem

title: Padaiyaanda Maaveeraa
actors: V. Gowthaman, Samuthirakani, Pujitha Poonada, Saranya Ponvannan
plot: Padaiyanda Maaveera is a political action-drama inspired by the life of firebrand leader Kaduvetti Guru, tracing his journey from grassroots activist to fearless community voice. Blending raw rural politics with emotional depth, it captures the charisma, confrontations, and legacy of a true warrior.

title: Gurram Paapi Reddy
actors: Faria Abdullah, Naresh Agastya, Rajiv Kumar Aneja
plot: Gurram Paapi Reddy and Soudamani enlist the help of three eccentric men named Military, Chilipi, and Goyyi to exhume a buried body from Srisailam and relocate it to a graveyard in Hyderabad. The risky task comes with a tempting promise of Rs 10 crore. As the mission unfolds, Gurram reveals that the act is part of a long planned revenge against two brothers from a royal lineage who had wronged him and Soudamani in the past. The wealthy brothers possess enormous riches, and Gurram’s larger plan is to extract a substantial sum from them. Does the plan unfold as intended? Is Gurram being truthful, or does he have a hidden agenda of his own?

actors: Shiva Rajkumar, Upendra, Raj B. Shetty, Kaustubha Mani
plot: Vinay is an IT employee. He dreams of getting killed after he hit a dog with his bike. The dream comes true, partially. He hits a dog, which is considered a mother to Rayappa. Rayappa sets a 45-day timeline to kill Vinay. Vinay loses his job, friends, and his lover, which breaks his heart. At this juncture, Shivanna crosses paths with Vinay. He offers help to Vinay and tries to change his life back to normal. Who is Shivanna? Why did he help Vinay? What happened to Rayappa’s challenge? The rest of the story speaks about this.

title: Patang
actors: Vijay Sekhar Anne, Sampath Maka, Suresh Reddy Kothinti
plot: Visky aka Vamsi Krishna and Arun are childhood friends who share a deep bond despite their contrasting backgrounds. Arun comes from a wealthy family, while Visky lives in a low-income basti. Trouble brews when Aishwarya, an indecisive young woman, enters their lives. She initially falls in love with Visky but gradually develops feelings for Arun. After a series of misunderstandings comes a resolution. Visky and Arun decide to compete in a Patang (kite-flying) championship, with the winner earning Aishwarya’s love. Who emerges as the champion forms the crux of the film.

title: Dhurandhar
actors: Ranveer Singh, Akshaye Khanna, R. Madhavan, Arjun Rampal, Sanjay Dut
plot: Ajay Sanyal has witnessed many unusual attacks from Pakistan towards India which has claimed many lives and his seniors blame him for his failed strategy. Sanyal plans for a secret operation called Dhurandhar.Humza a spy enters Pakistan with a mission to break networks of terrorism planning attacks against India.His brief plan is to enter the gang of Rehman Dacait whose one of the most powerful gangsters with huge network.This seems to be quite impossible but with the help of another spy Alam he manages to enter the gang.Humza soon becomes a trust worthy aide of Rehman and starts to send information to RAW via Alam.Rehman is eyeing upcoming elections his mentor Jameel Jamali fears of loosing his seat and decides to take help of SP Aslam Chaudhary to eliminate Rehman.Humza is looking for more networks of terrorism and saves Rehman.But is unaware that by going this way he has invited major destruction in his country.

title: Sarvam Maya
actors: Nivin Pauly, Riya Shibu, Aju Varghese, Priya Prakash Varrier
plot: a young Hindu priest residing alone in a large ancestral home filled with silence, rituals, and unspoken histories. His existence follows a strict routine until an unforeseen encounter with a ghost disrupts his meticulously organized life. What starts as a peculiar and mildly humorous haunting gradually transforms into a journey that compels the priest to face profound questions about faith, purpose, and the nature of reality.

title: Champion
actors: Roshann Meka, Anaswara Rajan, Santhosh Prathap, Murli Sharma
plot: Michael is a talented footballer whose life takes a major turn when he receives an offer from a Manchester football club to play in London. Determined to seize this rare opportunity, Michael agrees to secretly transport weapons. During his journey, he passes through Bhairanpally, a village bravely resisting the Razakars. Witnessing the villagers’ suffering and courage deeply impacts him, forcing Michael to rethink his ambitions and ultimately choose to stand up for his land and people.

title: Vaa Vaathiyaar
actors: Karthi, Krithi Shetty, Sathyaraj
plot: The story begins with Bhoomipichai, a devoted fan of the legendary actor and former Chief Minister M. G. Ramachandran. While watching an MGR film in a theatre, Bhoomipichai learns of MGR’s death. At that very moment, his grandson is born. Overwhelmed with emotion, he believes the child is destined to become the next MGR and raises him with strict values of honesty, discipline, and righteousness.

title: Cheekatilo
actors: Sobhita Dhulipala, Viswadev Rachakonda, Chaitanya Visalakshmi, Esha Chawla
plot: Sandhya is a fearless crime journalist working for a television channel, determined to expose the growing criminal underworld in the city. However, her uncompromising approach and hard-hitting investigations are constantly ignored by the channel’s management, forcing her to resign. unwilling to stay silent, Sandhya launches her own independent crime podcast, where she begins uncovering hidden stories that society prefers to overlook. Her life takes a disturbing turn when her close friend is found dead under suspicious circumstances. What initially appears to be an isolated incident soon leads Sandhya into a chilling series of interconnected murders. As she digs deeper, Sandhya crosses paths with a sharp and relentless police officer, who is leading the official investigation. With every revelation, the case pulls Sandhya closer to a haunting past that she has long tried to escape. The deeper she goes, the more dangerous the truth becomes, putting her life and sanity at risk.

title: Tere Ishk Mein
actors: Dhanush, Kriti Sanon, Prakash Raj, Priyanshu Painyuli

Sujatha falls in love with Ravi, a young man from a lower caste belonging to the same village. Enraged by his daughter’s relationship with someone from a caste he considers inferior and against his wishes, Shivaji takes a harsh and extreme decision.

title: Sight & Sound in Love
actors: Dev JBC, Navinkumar Kannadasan, Rupini Krishnan
plot: Two souls – a blind man and a mute woman – are brought together by music, emotions and an unbreakable bond.

title: Simple Manusan
actors: Hindravel Chandrabose, Mogan Chandra Das, Shamini Ramasamy
plot: A 32-year-old barber enjoys his modest life but struggles with a deep sense of loneliness, believing that marriage could fill the void. Under pressure from his family, friends, and society, he embarks on a quest to find the perfect partner, exploring everything from dating apps to traditional matchmakers. Despite this, he faces a series of disappointments and rejections. As his search spirals into frustration, he begins to doubt if the life he seeks is even possible or if he’s just chasing an illusion.

title: Mowgli
actors: Bandi Saroj Kumar, Roshan Kanakala, Sakshi Mhadolkar, Harsha Chemudu
production: Rama Maruthi, Sandeep Raj, Radhakrishna Reddy, India
plot: In Parvathipuram, Mowgli grows up almost like an orphan after losing his parents at a young age. Inspired by his late father, he dreams of becoming a police officer. When a film crew arrives in the village, he takes up work as a dupe artist and does small jobs for money. He soon falls for Jasmine, a deaf and mute dancer of the film’s crew. She, too, develops feelings for him after noticing that he shares the same unusually large foot size as her father. Complications arise when the film’s producer develops an unhealthy fascination for Jasmine. A brief misunderstanding distances Mowgli and Jasmine, but they reconcile once the confusion clears. Trouble resurfaces when a lecherous local police officer, Christopher Nolan, sets his eyes on Jasmine. The couple flees into the forest. The rest of the story explores whether Mowgli can protect Jasmine from this police officer.

title: Vazhikaaval

plot: On a long day shaped by duty & heat, two police escorts accompany a convict to court exposing the silent weight of responsibility behind an otherwise ordinary routine.

title: Angammal

production: Sudhahar Das, Perumal Murugan, Vipin Radhakrishnan, India
plot: In a rural Tamil Nadu village in the mid-1990s, a mother and son clash over one woman’s decision to live life on her own terms. The son, newly returned from the city and aspiring to marry into an urban family, insists his mother wear a blouse with her sari; she refuses, unwilling to give up her identity and comfort. Her defiance becomes a quiet act of rebellion against societal expectations, exposing deep-rooted prejudices about class, caste, and bodily autonomy.

title: Mask

His guru asks him to undergo intense spiritual training to gain greater divine powers to protect India and Sanatana Dharma from an upcoming threat.Meanwhile, a Tibet General and Chang plan to weaken India by destroying Sanatana Dharma, thereby removing people’s faith in God. Thakur also joins hands with them.

title: Eko
actors: Sandeep Pradeep, Vineeth, Narain Ram, Binu Pappu
plot: Set in the remote forest region of Kaattukunnu, Kerala, the film follows Mlaathi, also known as Soyi, a woman from Malaysia living in isolation. She is looked after by Peeyoos, appointed by her sons, along with a group of loyal Malaysian-breed dogs. Several people search for her husband Kuriachan, a dog breeder who has been missing for years after being implicated in a criminal case. His friend Mohan Pothan (Vineeth) is among those trying to trace him. Though many believe Kuriachan is hiding somewhere in the dense forest with the help of his trained dogs, his whereabouts remain unknown. Why so many people are searching for him, what role Peeyoos and the dogs truly play, and how a woman from Malaysia ended up living quietly in Kerala form the core mysteries of the film.

title: Drive
actors: Aadhi, Anish Kuruvilla, Madonna Sebastian

With some quirky characters in the loop, how will Rita manage to come out safe?

title: Vritta
actors: Chaithra J. Achar, Master Anurag, Maahir Mohiuddin
production: Yogesh Gowda, Raghu Niduvalli, Shankar Raman S., India
plot: Siddharth a quiet, withdrawn man whose life takes a dark and twisted turn after one impulsive decision.One night. One unexpected phone call. One wrong turn. And that’s all it takes to spiral into the unknown. What begins as a simple night drive unravels into something far more disturbing — a haunting journey through isolation, guilt, and fractured realities. As the silence deepens and the night stretches on, siddharth finds himself trapped in a circle he can’t escape. A circle called vritta.

title: Andhra King Taluka
actors: Ram Pothineni, Bhagyashri Borse, Upendra, hul Ramakrishna, Rao Ramesh, Murli Sharma
plot: Sagar, from a remote village, Godapalli Lanka, in Godavari district, is a die-hard fan of, ‘Andhra King’ Surya. Sagar falls in love with Mahalakshmi but her father ridicules Sagar by saying he’s no match for Mahalakshmi’s status. Sagar challenges Mahalakshmi’s father and says that he will build a big movie theatre in his remote village in no time and proves that he’s worth enough to marry Mahalakshmi. Just when everything seems to be going in favour of Sagar and Mahalakshmi’s love, Sagar decides to sell the theatre he built and send the money to his favourite hero, Surya. Why did Sagar send money to his favourite hero? Why did Ram want to build a theatre and that too in his remote village where they don’t even have access to electricity, What is the backstory of Sagar? How is Surya’s hundredth film related to Sagar’s love story, Did Sagar meet his favourite hero, Did Surya meet his die-hard fan, Did Sagar and Mahalakshmi get married eventually, Forms the rest of the story.

title: Middle Class
actors: Kaali Venkat, Munishkanth, Vijayalakshmi Ahathian

title: Maadan Kodai Vizha
actors: Sheeba Christy, Gokul Gowtham, Paulraj Mariappan
plot: Determined to revive a long-forgotten tradition, Murugan embarks on a mission to organize the annual Sudalai Madan ceremony, which has been defunct for years. However, his efforts are met with fierce resistance from various quarters. Adding to the challenge, Murugan’s girlfriend lays down an ultimatum: she will only marry him if he succeeds in pulling off the ceremony. Against all odds, Murugan perseveres, rallying the village community to support his cause. Will he triumph in his quest, and how will he overcome the hurdles to successfully organize the ceremony?

title: Rajini Gaang

To save Myna, Rajini teams up with his close friends and a priest, uncovering the truth behind the cursed thaali and facing the haunting tied to Ponnarasi’s story.

Meanwhile, Chaitanya is dealing with a low sperm-count issue. Can he make his wife a mother in 100 days?

Unexpectedly, Madi and Ramya meet at a wedding, and their matching opinions lead to their marriage. After the wedding, the story takes an unexpected turn.
